title: Affidavit

inlines.v: AFFIDA'VIT, noun [An old law verb in the perfect tense; he made oath; from ad and fides, faith.] A declaration upon oath. In the United States, more generally, a declaration in writing, signed by the party, and sworn to, before an authorized magistrate.
